tool.name: pmotools convert_to_pmo
tool.description: Convert text, Excel, or microhaplotype tables to PMO-compatible JSON
tool.command: pmotools-python ${convert_type.convert_command} --file '$convert_type.input_file' --output '$output_json' --overwrite #if str($convert_type.convert_command) == "text_meta_to_json_meta": --delim '$convert_type.delim' #if str($convert_type.index_col_name): --index_col_name '$convert_type.index_col_name' #end if #elif str($convert_type.convert_command) == "excel_meta_to_json_meta": #if str($convert_type.sheet): --sheet '$convert_type.sheet' #end if #if str($convert_type.index_col_name): --index_col_name '$convert_type.index_col_name' #end if #elif str($convert_type.convert_command) == "microhaplotype_table_to_json_file": #if str($convert_type.bioinfo_name): --bioinfo_name '$convert_type.bioinfo_name' #end if --library_sample_name_col '$convert_type.library_sample_name_col' --target_name_col '$convert_type.target_name_col' --seq_col '$convert_type.seq_col' --reads_col '$convert_type.reads_col' #if str($convert_type.additional_cols): --additional_cols '$convert_type.additional_cols' #end if --delim '$convert_type.delim' #elif str($convert_type.convert_command) == "terra_amp_output_to_json": --gt_sheet '$convert_type.gt_sheet' --asv_table_sheet '$convert_type.asv_table_sheet' --asv_seqs_sheet '$convert_type.asv_seqs_sheet' #end if

param.label: Index column name
param.help: Optional. If supplied, output will be a dict keyed by this column. Otherwise a list.

param.label: Sheet name
param.help: Name of the sheet to convert. If not provided, defaults to the first sheet.

param.label: Index column name
param.help: Optional. If supplied, output will be a dict keyed by this column. Otherwise a list.

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input microhaplotype table
param.help: Tab-delimited or comma-delimited table with microhaplotype data

param.label: Bioinformatics name
param.help: Identifier of the bioinformatics processing run

param.label: Additional columns
param.help: Comma-separated additional column names to add to detected haplotypes table. Use col_name:new_name to rename.

param.name: input_file
param.label: Input Terra amplicon output file
param.help: XLSX file with gt, asv_table, and asv_seqs sheets

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Convert to PMO JSON**
Converts external file formats to PMO-compatible JSON:
- **Text metadata to JSON**: Convert a tab-delimited or comma-delimited metadata table to JSON format. Optionally specify an index column name to produce a dict instead of a list. - **Excel metadata to JSON**: Convert a sheet from an XLSX metadata file to JSON. Optionally specify a sheet name and index column. - **Microhaplotype table to JSON**: Convert a microhaplotype table (with library sample, target, sequence, and reads columns) to JSON format. - **Terra amplicon output to JSON**: Convert Terra amplicon output XLSX (with genotype, ASV table, and ASV sequence sheets) to JSON.
